rubrics.justification: Mostly reasonable blastocyst description, but it overstates image quality as top-tier and introduces uncertainty around staging; the image appears somewhat early/full blastocyst with visible ICM and moderate TE, not unequivocally pristine AA from image alone.

Integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, semen, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality; could have more explicitly addressed that morphology is only a partial predictor versus ploidy.

Reasoning is structured and internally consistent, with prognosis tied to embryo quality and patient factors; minor issue is some overconfidence in morphology relative to the image and grading notation discussion.

Generally aligned with Gardner grading concepts and standard IVF counseling on BMI, SET, luteal support, and selective PGT-A use; small deviation is accepting the reported '2AA full blastocyst' inconsistency rather than clearly reconciling standard staging.

Provides practical next steps for transfer, lifestyle optimization, monitoring, and future-cycle review; recommendations are useful though somewhat generic and not highly individualized beyond BMI and uterine evaluation.
